prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1423; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured for this incident, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please confirm receipt of this request in writing.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, claim file materials, vehicle data, and any repair or appraisal records. Please ensure that this material is not altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt response.
